UserList.title: UserList
UserList.description: A user-created custom collection or list for saving video summaries, books, articles, and notes.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the list owner.

description.description: Optional description of what this list is for.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the list was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the list was last updated.

ListItem.title: ListItem
ListItem.description: An individual saved video summary, book, research paper, article, or note inside a UserList subcollection.

listId.description: ID of the parent UserList document.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the item owner.

title.description: Title of the saved video, book, article, or note.

url.description: Source URL for the saved item.

content.description: Saved markdown summary, quote, or excerpt.

notes.description: Personal user notes on this saved item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

/lists/{listId}.description: Top-level collection storing custom user lists.

/lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}.description: Subcollection storing saved items belonging to a specific UserList.
